# ScaleFree_Dynamics_Encoding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The explicit representation of power-law or scale-invariant temporal patterns in neural signals within a transformer's attention mechanism. Enables TCC/iNEST systems to preserve and exploit long-range, hierarchical dependencies in sparse biological or network data.
